import {db} from './test-store';
import {hashText} from './writing-input';
import {researchCredentialHit} from './topic-research-security';
import {editorialCredentialVariants,editorialCredentialInspection} from './editorial-credential-text';
// New editorial boundary only. Existing legacy/provider behavior remains unchanged.
export async function editorialCredentialHit(owner:string,value:unknown,extra:string[]=[]):Promise<boolean>{
 let variants:unknown[];try{variants=editorialCredentialVariants(value);}catch{return true;}
 const ids=new Set<string>();for(const variant of variants){const raw=typeof variant==='string'?variant:JSON.stringify(variant)||'';for(const id of raw.match(/[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}/gi)||[])ids.add(id.toLowerCase());}if(ids.size>1000)return true;
 const hashes=(await db().prepare('SELECT claim_hash FROM editorial_requests WHERE owner=? AND claim_hash IS NOT NULL').bind(owner).all<{claim_hash:string}>()).results.map(r=>r.claim_hash);for(const id of ids)if(hashes.includes(await hashText(id)))return true;
 const stageTokens=(await db().prepare('SELECT token FROM editorial_stages WHERE owner=?').bind(owner).all<{token:string}>()).results.map(r=>r.token);
 const known=[...extra,...stageTokens];if(editorialCredentialInspection(value,known))return true;
 // Bounded overlapping inspection avoids introducing the topic helper's 600k
 // aggregate limit as a new SSE response/token cap. It keeps its percent/key rules.
 for(const variant of variants){if(typeof variant!=='string')continue;for(let at=0;at<variant.length;at+=60000)if(await researchCredentialHit(owner,variant.slice(at,at+64096),known))return true;}return false;
}
